label: Test coordinated fulfillment and operative plan identification
description: A placed diagnostic for 4be0f774, distinct from the favouring and controlled-dependence diagnostics da0125fd and b5fe7a87 (#2163): it asks whether supplying a plan's component outputs supplies its required fit, and whether natural reports or a supplied public surgery identify operative use. Both verdicts hold by construction of finite fixtures. In the coordination fixture fit is an independent background bit, so the component readout cannot identify fulfillment while the full readout trivially can. In the operation fixture the existing practical-specification controls (4814527f: the foreseen plan is appraised and satisfied yet lacks coverage) are paired with the responsive and idle SCMs by a supplied profile bit; natural reports agree in every context, the cut report differs, so the augmented report identifies coverage and the nonempty intervention selector's verdict matches it only under that stipulated pairing. No real-world admissible intervention on the source, no general reduction of practical direction to intervention sensitivity and no premise is established.
